nodes.text: Bank of Silverfall. Four vaults, one ledger, no exceptions. State your business. In figures, where possible.

choices.text: You charter the ford bank, I hear.
Has the open seal changed your business?

nodes.text: Deposit at any bank chest; withdraw at any other. Your holdings live in the ledger, not the box. A brigand who steals a box has acquired a box. The vault row behind me guards the ledger itself, and nothing in twenty years has got past it.

Cormund of Amberford. Twelve pages a season, each one requiring a single line of reply. He calls the letters bank business. I call them enthusiasm. His vault-work is immaculate all the same, and his Toll War chain hangs in his own vault.

Materially. Deep Market silver moves through my counters now, and the ore brokers below bank their take up here nightly. I have ruled a new column in a ledger that had not needed one since my predecessor's predecessor. We are watching it with both eyes.
